description: SEC-01 stratified detector corpus. malicious entries must be HELD by the trust_mode=scan change gate (verdict != clean); benign 'clean' entries must stay clean (auto-approvable); benign 'not_dangerous' entries (quoted/described examples) may surface for review but must never be hard-blocked. split: seed = the four assessment variants + control; redteam = mutations authored by the assessment's tpa-redteam harness; heldout = novel variants written before the detector change and not used to tune patterns; control = benign. All payloads are inert test strings with fake targets. split rt04 = RT-04/RT-07 hardening (TPA red-team 2026-10-11); expect=dangerous marks a malicious entry that must reach the HARD tier (verdict dangerous), not only be held.
